thread:
Marco: Need a quick onboarding bench for orion-9b-v2 before tomorrow's perf sync. Looking for smoke + full run so we can set defaults in the catalog. Short checklist: p95 for seq=256/512, throughput for batch 1/4/8, peak GPU memory, KV-cache usage, and perf traces. Prefer FP16 first; try q4 if its low effort. Artifacts to s3://redwood-bench/orion-9b-v2/<run_ts>.

Evan: I can cover FP16 baseline. Jia, want q4 attempt?

Marco: Evan FP16 is priority. Jia q4 optional but helpful. Use /bench/prompts/short_chat_prompts.json and include a small eval (30 prompts) to check quality drift.

Jia: Starting smoke in ~20m on node gpu32-03. Command Ill run:
```
run_bench --model orion-9b-v2 \n  --seq 256,512 \n  --batches 1,4,8 \n  --mode smoke,full \n  --output s3://redwood-bench/orion-9b-v2/1899991110\n```
Capturing traces + flamegraphs. Will upload kernel prof.

perf-ci-bot: Bench job queued on gpu32-03. Est runtime 35m. Job id: bench-1899991110-01

Jia: Smoke results (short):
- FP16 seq=256 b1: p50=18ms, p95=62ms, tokens/s=9.8k
- FP16 seq=512 b1: p50=36ms, p95=112ms, tokens/s=5.2k
- Scaling (seq=256): b1=9.8k, b4=34.0k, b8=58.2k tokens/s
- Peak GPU mem (seq=512): 21.6GB
Artifacts: s3://redwood-bench/orion-9b-v2/1899991110/smoke/ 
Flamegraph + traces uploaded. Runtime chose flash-causal when available.

Sophia: Nice. Can you confirm whether fused-kernels were used for the b4/b8 runs? Also add a short note if any prompts trigger long-tail attention spikes.

Jia: Yes fused kernels on b4/b8. I observed 3 prompts with ~2x latency tail at seq=512; captured in trace.

Evan: I pulled the smoke artifacts and ran a quick compare to our internal baseline-8b-fp16 (same node): orion-9b-v2 shows ~1.15x higher p95 at seq=512 but about 1.12x better throughput at b4 due to improved parallel matmul patterns. Memory delta ~+1.4GB. Compare table at s3://redwood-bench/orion-9b-v2/1899991110/compare/

perf-ci-bot: Full bench finished. Full report: s3://redwood-bench/orion-9b-v2/1899991110/full_report.html
Key full-run numbers:
- seq=256, b1: p95=68ms, tokens/s=10.0k
- seq=512, b1: p95=118ms, tokens/s=5.1k
- seq=256, b4: p95=330ms, tokens/s=33.6k
- KV-cache peak: 3.6GB
- Peak GPU mem (full): 22.1GB

Marco: Good. Two asks: (1) run the 30-prompt eval to check q4 quality if Jia can slot it tomorrow morning, (2) add a one-line recommendation to the onboarding sheet (model, recommended mode, perf highlights, mem req).

Jia: Will schedule q4 run tomorrow AM. If eval metric drop <=2% we'll propose q4 as optional for cost-sensitive customers; otherwise default to fp16.

Sophia: I'll draft the catalog PR with: default=fp16, production-batch=b4, note: requires >=24GB GPU for seq=512 stable. Will include links to flamegraph and full_report.

Evan: Im digging into kernel traces now. Early finding: attention kernel has a tail on a few sequences; filing INF-1198 to try alternate attention ordering and check kernel launches.

Marco: Perfect  thanks team. Once q4 eval completes well finalize Dedicated sizing for this model. Marco out.
